Introduction

KIMMUSEUM is a South Korean singer-songwriter known for his introspective lyrics and emotionally rich soundscapes. He made his debut in 2018 with the single “Perfume”, and gained attention the following year with “Between Morning and Afternoon”, a track inspired by his personal experience of a breakup, which resonated deeply with listeners. KIMMUSEUM continued to explore a range of emotional themes through songs like “PALETTE” and “Paint Laurent”, painting vivid sonic landscapes with his music. In August 2020, he released his first extended play, [281.31km], encapsulating the feelings and discoveries from an aimless yet meaningful journey. His full-length debut album, [BLUE FOREST], further established his unique artistic identity, followed by notable works such as “Round And Round”, “galleria”, and “Grow Old”, showcasing his continued growth and refined musicality.
